title: Shipping price sheet readable without comments
task: Compute shipping in package `shipping`: `Cost(grams int, zone Zone) (int, error)` for domestic and international zones. Under 500g: 350 cents domestic, 900 international. From 500g up to 2000g: 550 / 1600. Over 2000g: 550 / 1600 plus 100 / 300 per started kilogram beyond 2000g. An unknown zone is an error. A reader should be able to see the price sheet in the code itself, without comments.
